title: yosoi::action::assert_all
signature: pub fn assert_all<C: yosoi::contracts::ValidateContract + 'static>(plan: &yosoi::locators::Plan, checks: impl IntoIterator<Item = yosoi::assertions::Check<'static, C>>) -> yosoi::action::AssertionBuilder
docs:
Builds a typed local Contract assertion using owned Rust predicates.
Convert it into [`Step`] for one immediate capture, or call `.until()` to
keep observing until its predicates pass.
